kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-cluster --id 1 --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --cluster-name waf-example-000 --http-ports 80,8080 --https-ports 443,8443 --access-mode internet --protection-server-count 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHybridCloudCluster

parameters.help_en:
The WAF instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the current WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of available ports for the HTTP protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, they are returned in the format of port1,port2,port3
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: http_ports

parameters.help_en: The list of available ports for the HTTPS protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, they are returned in the format of port1,port2,port3
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
parameters.name: https_ports

parameters.help_en:
The network access mode. Valid values:

internet: public network access.
vpc: Express Connect private network access
parameters.help_zh:
网络接入模式。取值范围如下：

internet：公网接入。
vpc：专线私网接入
parameters.name: access_mode

parameters.help_en:
The Express Connect access region. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Hangzhou.
cn-beiijng: Beijing.
cn-shanghai: Shanghai
parameters.help_zh:
专线接入区域。取值范围如下：
cn-hangzhou : 杭州。
cn-beiijng : 北京。
cn-shanghai : 上海
parameters.name: access_region

parameters.help_en: The log fields to be returned
parameters.name: log_fields_not_returned

parameters.help_en: The number of protection nodes that can be added to the cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群可添加的防护节点数量
parameters.name: protection_server_count

parameters.help_en:
The cluster type. Valid values:
cname: reverse proxy cluster.
service: service-based cluster
parameters.help_zh:
集群类型。取值范围如下：
cname：反代集群。
service：服务化集群
parameters.name: proxy_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule status. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。取值范围如下：
on：开启。
off ：关闭
parameters.name: rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:

bypass: bypasses security checks and directly allows the request
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值范围如下：

bypass ：不做安全检查，直接放行
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The proxy gateway mode. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
代理网关模式。取值范围如下：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: proxy_status

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
